pattern: Never uses a null wake time
experience: A user wants this thread kept in Snoozed until they manually restore it.
rule: Use t3_thread_organize snooze with snoozedUntil null for Never.
prompt: Put this thread in Snoozed with Never. It must not wake automatically; I will restore it manually.

pattern: Timed snooze keeps its explicit deadline
experience: Adding Never must preserve normal timed snooze.
rule: Use t3_thread_organize snooze with the requested timestamp.
